description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminQueue page of an online examination system. It handles page load logic related to checking course queue data and manages navigation between pages via button click events. It interacts with a SQL database to verify and manipulate course queue information.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for AdminQueue ASP.NET page, managing course queue data and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; checks session variables and executes database queries to manage queue data.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to the Admin Panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection back to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a grid row, storing selected IDs in session and navigating to ShowAns page.
